title: Document GLSL LDPC shader plan as superseded by HIP
description:
Document that the older GLSL/Vulkan LDPC shader plan is superseded by the HIP LDPC BP prototype story.

## Background

This issue previously requested a GLSL compute shader for LDPC min-sum BP. The confirmed `806eb14e` backend direction is HIP/ROCm only. LDPC implementation work now belongs under the HIP LDPC BP story and issue `37e0b235`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] The issue no longer asks workers to implement GLSL or Vulkan compute shaders.
- [hard] The cleanup note points LDPC GPU implementation work to the HIP LDPC BP story and `dev/active/gpu-batch-ldpc-bp-plan.md`.
- [hard] Any useful benchmark or feasibility wording from the original GLSL task is represented in the HIP LDPC BP task or final feasibility report task.
- [hard] Default workspace CI remains unaffected.

## Notes

No production code changes are expected unless stale planning references need cleanup.
